answer_1.quote: NEO-BENCH consists of 4 tasks -3 downstream and 1 intrinsic metric -to evaluate models' knowledge of neologisms: (i) Machine Translation with human and automatic evaluation; (ii) Cloze Question Answering to evaluate models in context; (iii) Definition Generation to evaluate models in a context-free setting; and (iv) perplexity...

answer_2.quote: We work with in-house native speakers to create reference translations (English to Chinese) and evaluate system outputs in Table 5 with BLEU , COMET , and MetricX-23 (XXL and XL). We also use the reference‑free metrics COMETKiwi and MetricX-23‑QE (XXL and XL).

answer_3.quote: We use GPT‑4 to evaluate if model generations are semantically equivalent to the gold reference. We also measure the Cohen's Kappa between automatic GPT‑4 and human evaluation, indicating GPT‑4 was used as an automatic judge.
methods: automatic MT quality assessment via GPT‑4
criteria: better vs. worse compared to reference

answer_4.quote: MT output is manually annotated with hand‑crafted labels of increasing error severity... Annotators were provided the input sentence, the neologism, and the definition and were instructed to select the label corresponding to the worst translation error. ... We measure the Cohen's Kappa between automatic GPT‑4 and human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each translation according to the most severe error category (Good, Unnatural, Literal, Partial, Mistranslation, Copy, Incomprehensible) following the MQM‑derived guidelines.
